ranking_basis: Exploratory hypothesis novelty and research tractability only. This is not product priority, clinical importance or evidence strength; the ranked output lanes in docs/SENSOR_TO_OUTPUT_AUDIT.md govern implementation order.
promotion_rule: Frozen definition, quality tests, reference agreement, chronological person-level holdout, prospective calibration, subgroup/device robustness and clinical/human-factors review are all required.

hypotheses.name: Co-timed ECG–PPG timing and morphology fingerprint
hypotheses.falsifiable_test: Confirm cadence/timestamps, test same-session and day-to-day repeatability, then determine whether derived timing/morphology adds stable information after contact, posture and temperature controls.
hypotheses.allowed_output: Qualified timing or morphology changed from the personal reference; cause unknown.

hypotheses.name: Activity-conditioned cardiac cost and recovery reserve
hypotheses.falsifiable_test: Repeat the same externally reviewed physical configuration, hold on human concern before sensor scoring, and test whether task time plus residual/recovery features are reliable and prospectively associated with preregistered fatigue/function outcomes.
hypotheses.allowed_output: Response to the matched research protocol changed across independent signal families.

hypotheses.name: Persistent multisystem early-change trajectory
hypotheses.falsifiable_test: Precommit thresholds and compare lead time and sensitivity at a fixed false-alert budget against single-metric controls.
hypotheses.allowed_output: Several independent qualified systems are more unusual than the matched personal pattern; a person's concern remains independently actionable even when sensors are normal.

hypotheses.name: IBD-associated personal physiological trajectory
hypotheses.falsifiable_test: Freeze the model and prospectively score lead time, calibration and false alerts per week for a predefined lab-confirmed outcome window.
hypotheses.allowed_output: The current pattern resembles a previously recorded physiology-and-symptom context.

hypotheses.name: Fatigue, functional capacity and glucocorticoid-context trajectory
hypotheses.falsifiable_test: Pre-register fatigue and functional outcomes, test whether qualified physiology plus context improves prospective prediction over persistence, and separately measure whether any association survives sleep, illness, exertion and glucocorticoid-withdrawal confounding.
hypotheses.allowed_output: Fatigue, function or posture-response context changed from the personal pattern; the watch cannot determine the cause.

hypotheses.name: Overnight oxygen burden and pulse-response proxy
hypotheses.falsifiable_test: Test paired-night agreement for area, duration, event recovery and pulse-response metrics before any user-facing screening output.
hypotheses.allowed_output: Qualified overnight oxygen stability trend or research burden proxy.

hypotheses.name: Circadian phase, amplitude and cross-rhythm alignment
hypotheses.falsifiable_test: Compare preregistered consistent-schedule and usual-routine blocks for phase alignment, fatigue and sleep-regularity outcomes.
hypotheses.allowed_output: Personal rhythms appear more or less aligned than the matched reference.

hypotheses.name: Posture-linked autonomic and presyncope response signature
hypotheses.falsifiable_test: First characterize Ultra2 timing against continuous BP and ECG under an externally reviewed protocol; then require external-site and prospective free-living validation with false alerts per person-week before any presyncope claim.
hypotheses.allowed_output: The posture-response timing or recovery changed from the qualified personal reference.

hypotheses.name: Mobility reserve and frailty-associated trajectory
hypotheses.falsifiable_test: Estimate test-retest reliability and association with standardized walk/chair-rise reference measures.
hypotheses.allowed_output: Personal movement and recovery pattern changed.

hypotheses.name: Workload-adjusted heat-strain response
hypotheses.falsifiable_test: Test whether the fused response tracks reference strain better than heart rate or sweat estimate alone.
hypotheses.allowed_output: Heat and workload response differs from matched personal sessions.

hypotheses.name: Multi-frequency bioimpedance spectral fingerprint
hypotheses.falsifiable_test: Quantify standardized morning repeatability and whether spectral changes track reference fluid-state measures.
hypotheses.allowed_output: The standardized impedance spectrum changed from the personal reference.
